title: Weighted-AoI-Driven UAV Trajectory and Reporting for Dynamic CKM Tracking
abstract: arXiv:2611.13726v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing channel knowledge map (CKM) construction assumes quasi-static environments, failing when channels rapidly decorrelate. This paper investigates continuous online dynamic CKM tracking over an airborne 2D plane via a UAV fleet. We formulate a long-term error minimization problem under UAV mobility and reporting constraints. This problem, however, is intractable with unobservable errors for unmeasured cells. To tackle this, we propose a metric-driven scheduling approach featuring the Weighted-Age of Information (W-AoI). W-AoI evaluates cells by combining exact temporal staleness with spatial uncertainty predicted by a 2D U-Net. We prove that top-$K$ W-AoI selection maximizes the one-slot error reduction bound. Guided by this guarantee, we develop a lightweight greedy trajectory policy incorporating continuous along-path sensing. Simulations demonstrate our method reduces steady-state error by 3.8 dB$^2$ and 4.8 dB$^2$ over AoI-only

translated_title: 加权信息年龄驱动的无人机轨迹与上报方法用于动态信道知识地图追踪
translated_abstract: 现有的信道知识地图构建方法假设环境是准静态的，当信道快速去相关时便会失效。本文研究了利用无人机机群在空中二维平面上进行连续在线动态CKM追踪的问题。我们在无人机移动性和上报约束条件下，构建了一个长期误差最小化问题。然而，由于未测量小区的误差不可观测，该问题难以求解。为解决这一难题，我们提出了一种以加权信息年龄为核心的度量驱动调度方法。W-AoI通过将精确的时间陈旧性与由2D U-Net预测的空间不确定性相结合来评估各个小区。我们证明了选取W-AoI值最高的前K个小区可使单时隙误差降低上界最大化。在该理论保证的指导下，我们进一步开发了一种融合沿路径连续感知的轻量级贪心轨迹策略。仿真结果表明，与仅基于AoI的方法相比，本文方法将稳态误差分别降低了3.8 dB²和4.8 dB²。
tldr: 本文提出加权信息年龄驱动的无人机轨迹规划与上报方法，通过结合精确的时间陈旧性与U-Net预测的空间不确定性来调度测量，实现动态信道知识地图的连续在线追踪，并证明了top-K选择策略可最大化单时隙误差降低上界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Weighted-Age of Information (W-AoI) driven UAV trajectory and reporting approach for continuous online dynamic channel knowledge map (CKM) tracking, which evaluates cells by combining exact temporal staleness with U-Net-predicted spatial uncertainty and proves that top-K W-AoI selection maximizes the one-slot error reduction bound.
